verdict.rationale: Persona's docs confirm government-ID verification checks and that verification details can be fetched via API beyond pass/fail status (persona-docs-27, persona-docs-45, persona-docs-12), implying structured data retrieval, but no evidence explicitly lists the extracted fields (name, DOB, document number, address, expiry) as retrievable API attributes. Missing for 10: explicit API schema/field reference showing extracted document fields, and confirmation these are returned per-session rather than just verification status.
